quote.text: I can never remember my child's medications at the doctor

promise.text: How to keep an accurate medication list

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "medication"

lines.text: Record each product, strength, instructions and actual use, including occasional medicines and supplements.
Flag differences for a pharmacist to resolve.

items.text: Identify the person and write the date of this check.
Record each medicine or supplement by its actual label name and strength or concentration.
Copy the current instructions for amount, route, timing and any relevant conditions without converting units yourself.
Write actual use separately if it differs from the instruction.
Add the prescriber or relevant contact and the purpose if confirmed; mark unknown information as unknown.
Separate active, stopped and uncertain entries.

line.text: They are written down per person, with dose and how often, on whatever device is in your hand at the desk, and stopped ones leave the list.
